timeline.title: The Recipe Begins
timeline.text: A grandmother in Jakarta starts hand-pulling noodles for the whole neighbourhood.

timeline.title: Bakmi Jakarta Opens
timeline.text: The family opens its first proper stall in Jakarta, recipe unchanged.

timeline.title: Landing in Bali
timeline.text: Bakmi Jakarta CC brings the same bowl to Bali's shores for the first time.

timeline.title: A Home for Everyone
timeline.text: A family-run favourite for locals, digital nomads and travellers passing through.

aboutParagraphs: Bakmi Jakarta CC began as a family recipe long before it became a restaurant — noodles hand-pulled in a small Jakarta kitchen, served to neighbours who kept coming back. Today the same recipe, the same broth, and the same care greet families, tourists and regulars across a warm dining room in Bali.
Every table here is treated like it's the only one in the house — because that's how the recipe was always meant to be shared.
